source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 17 exercise hal (PDF 15-16): MCQs wajah ke saath, short, constructed response aur descriptive jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 17 (Group 2 Elements) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab wajah ke saath diya gaya hai; short, constructed response aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi.
Q1. Mutiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Heading mein “Mutiple” chhapa hai; sahi lafz “Multiple” hai.

blocks.prompt:
I) Which Group 2 oxide forms the most alkaline solution in water?
(Kaun sa Group 2 oxide pani mein sab se zyada alkaline (khaari) solution banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh oxides basic hain: O²⁻(s) + H₂O(l) → 2OH⁻(aq). Group mein neeche jaate hue basic character barhta hai aur hydroxides zyada hal hote hain, is liye zyada OH⁻ banta hai. Chaaron mein Sr sab se neeche hai, is liye SrO sab se zyada alkaline solution deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
II) Which Group 2 element does not react with water or steam?
(Kaun sa Group 2 element pani ya steam (bhaap) se reaction nahi karta?)

options.text: Tamam Group 2 metals reaction karti hain

blocks.explanation: Beryllium garam karne par bhi pani ya steam se reaction nahi karta, kyun ke is par oxide ki hifazati (protective) teh hoti hai. Mg thande pani se aahista aur steam se tez reaction karta hai; Ca aasani se karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
III) What are the products when magnesium reacts with steam?
(Magnesium steam se reaction kare to kya products bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Steam ke saath: Mg(s) + H₂O(g) → MgO(s) + H₂(g). (Thande pani ke saath aahista reaction mein Mg(OH)₂ aur H₂ bante hain.)

blocks.prompt:
IV) The species formed when a Group 2 basic oxide (e.g., CaO) reacts with water:
(Group 2 ka basic oxide (maslan CaO) pani se reaction kare to kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: CaO(s) + H₂O(l) → Ca(OH)₂; oxide ion pani se proton leta hai: O²⁻ + H₂O → 2OH⁻. Metal hydroxide banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
V) Which Group 2 carbonate is the most thermally stable?
(Kaun sa Group 2 carbonate garmi mein sab se zyada mustahkam (thermally stable) hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbonates ki thermal stability group mein neeche barhti hai (Table 17.3): BeCO₃ 250 °C, MgCO₃ 540 °C, CaCO₃ 900 °C, SrCO₃ 1289 °C, BaCO₃ 1360 °C. BaCO₃ ko sab se zyada temperature chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
VI) What are the products of heating a Group 2 nitrate (e.g., Ca(NO₃)₂)?
(Group 2 nitrate (maslan Ca(NO₃)₂) ko garam karne se kya products bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: 2Ca(NO₃)₂(s) → 2CaO(s) + 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g): metal oxide, bhoori (brown) nitrogen dioxide aur oxygen.

blocks.prompt:
VII) The reason for the increasing thermal stability of Group 2 nitrates down the group is:
(Group mein neeche Group 2 nitrates ki thermal stability barhne ki wajah:)
blocks.explanation: Neeche jaate hue M²⁺ ion bara hota hai, is ki polarizing power (anion ke electron baadal ko bigaarne ki taqat) kam hoti hai. Yeh NO₃⁻ ko kam bigaarta hai, N–O bonds kam kamzor hote hain, is liye zyada garmi chahiye. Charge +2 hi rehta hai aur nitrate ion wohi hai.

blocks.prompt:
VIII) Which Group 2 sulphate is the least soluble in water?
(Kaun sa Group 2 sulphate pani mein sab se kam hal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sulphates ki solubility group mein neeche kam hoti hai (Table 17.4): MgSO₄ 1.83 × 10⁻¹, CaSO₄ 4.66 × 10⁻³, BaSO₄ 9.43 × 10⁻⁷ mol/100 g pani. BaSO₄ sab se kam hal hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
IX) Which of the following is the least soluble in water?
(In mein se kaun pani mein sab se kam hal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Table 17.4 (mol/100 g pani, 298 K):
Mg(OH)₂ = 2 × 10⁻⁵
Ba(OH)₂ = 1.5 × 10⁻²
MgSO₄ = 1.83 × 10⁻¹
BaSO₄ = 9.43 × 10⁻⁷ (sab se kam)
BaSO₄ sab se kam hal hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
X) Why does Be²⁺ form complexes more easily than Ba²⁺?
(Be²⁺ Ba²⁺ ke muqable mein complexes aasani se kyun banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Be²⁺ Group 2 ka sab se chhota ion hai (31 pm, jab ke Ba²⁺ 135 pm) aur charge wohi +2 hai, is liye is ki charge density (charge aur size ki nisbat) sab se zyada hai. Yeh electron pair dene walon ke lone pairs ko zor se kheenchta hai, maslan [Be(H₂O)₄]²⁺.

blocks.prompt:
a) Exactly 0.1 moles of calcium hydroxide and barium hydroxide are added to separate beakers containing 100 cm³ of water and stirred to form saturated solutions. Explain which solution has the higher pH value.
0.1 mol Ca(OH)₂ aur 0.1 mol Ba(OH)₂ alag alag 100 cm³ pani mein dal kar saturated solutions banaye gaye. Kis ki pH zyada hogi?
blocks.explanation: Ba(OH)₂ wale solution ki pH zyada hogi. 0.1 mol dono ki hal hone ki had se zyada hai, is liye dono saturated hain. Ba(OH)₂ zyada hal hota hai (1.5 × 10⁻² mol/100 g pani) aur Ca(OH)₂ kam (1.5 × 10⁻³ mol/100 g), is liye Ba(OH)₂ mein taqreeban das guna zyada OH⁻ ions hain; zyada [OH⁻] yani zyada pH.

blocks.prompt:
b) The size of dichromate ion is larger than the sulphate ion. Following the pattern for the solubilities of Group 2 sulphates, predict which of calcium dichromate and strontium dichromate is more soluble in water?
Dichromate ion sulphate se bara hai. Sulphates ke pattern ke mutabiq calcium dichromate aur strontium dichromate mein se kaun zyada hal hoga?
blocks.explanation: Calcium dichromate zyada hal hoga. Bare anion (jaise SO₄²⁻) ke saath Group 2 mein solubility neeche kam hoti hai, kyun ke M²⁺ ki hydration enthalpy lattice enthalpy se zyada girti hai. Dichromate ion aur bhi bara hai, is liye yahi pattern lagega: chhota aur zyada hydrate hone wala Ca²⁺ zyada hal hone wala salt deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
c) Write balanced equations for the reaction of Ba with cold water.
Ba ke thande pani se reaction ki balanced equation likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Ba(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Ba(OH)₂(aq) + H₂(g)
Barium thande pani se tezi se reaction kar ke barium hydroxide solution aur hydrogen gas deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
d) Why does Be metal form a protective layer on reacting with air while other members do not do so? Explain in terms of the strength of bonding between Be²⁺ and oxide ion.
Be hawa se reaction kar ke hifazati teh kyun banata hai jab ke baqi members nahi? Be²⁺ aur oxide ion ke darmiyan bond ki taqat se samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Be²⁺ bohat chhota (31 pm) aur +2 charge wala hai, is liye is ki charge density bohat zyada hai aur yeh O²⁻ ko bohat zor se kheenchta hai; Be–O bonding bohat mazboot hai. Is liye BeO ki patli, mazboot aur chipki hui teh metal ko dhak kar mazeed reaction rok deti hai. Bare M²⁺ ions oxide se kamzor bond banate hain, is liye un ki teh is tarah hifazat nahi karti.

blocks.prompt:
e) Predict the products of the thermal decomposition of barium nitrate. Write the chemical equation.
Barium nitrate ki thermal decomposition (garmi se toot) ke products aur equation likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Products: barium oxide, nitrogen dioxide (bhoori gas) aur oxygen.
2Ba(NO₃)₂(s) → 2BaO(s) + 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g) (tez garmi par)
Ba(NO₃)₂ sab se stable Group 2 nitrate hai, is liye sab se zyada temperature chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
f) Why does solubility of Group 2 hydroxides increase in terms of the relative changes in ΔHhyd and ΔHlattice?
ΔHhyd aur ΔHlattice ki tabdeeli ke lihaz se Group 2 hydroxides ki solubility kyun barhti hai?
blocks.explanation: Neeche jaate hue cation bara hota hai, is liye M²⁺ ki ΔHhyd (hydration enthalpy) aur M(OH)₂ ki ΔHlattice (lattice enthalpy) dono kam hoti hain. Chhote OH⁻ ion ki wajah se lattice enthalpy hydration enthalpy se zyada kam hoti hai. Is liye ΔHsoln zyada mufeed (zyada negative ya kam positive) ho jati hai aur solubility Mg(OH)₂ se Ba(OH)₂ tak barhti hai.

blocks.prompt:
g) In Dow Process, write the balanced equation for the precipitation of magnesium ions from seawater.
Dow Process mein samandari pani se magnesium ions ke precipitation (thos ban kar alag hone) ki equation likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Mg²⁺(aq) + Ca(OH)₂(s) → Mg(OH)₂(s) + Ca²⁺(aq)
Calcium hydroxide (limestone ya seepiyon se) samandari pani se na-hal hone wala magnesium hydroxide alag kar deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
h) State one medical use of BaSO₄ and Mg(OH)₂ each.
BaSO₄ aur Mg(OH)₂ ka aik aik tibbi (medical) istemal likhein.
blocks.explanation:
BaSO₄: “barium meal” mein nizam-e-hazm (digestive system) ke X-ray ke liye; yeh X-rays ko rok leta hai aur bilkul hal nahi hota, is liye mehfooz hai.
Mg(OH)₂ (milk of magnesia): antacid, maide ka zaid tezaab khatam karta hai; halka laxative (qabz kusha) bhi hai.

blocks.text: Q3. Constructed Response Questions (soch kar likhne wale sawal)

blocks.prompt:
a) Why the melting point and density of beryllium are higher than other Group 2 elements?
Beryllium ka melting point aur density baqi Group 2 elements se zyada kyun hai?
blocks.explanation:
Melting point: Be ke atoms sab se chhote hain (metallic radius 112 pm), is liye cations aur do valence electrons bohat qareeb hain; metallic bonding sab se mazboot hai aur melting point sab se zyada (1287 °C).
Density: chhote atoms qareeb qareeb packed hain, is liye Be (1.85 g/cm³) Mg (1.74) aur Ca (1.54) se zyada dense hai. Lekin Sr (2.64) aur Ba (3.51) apne bohat zyada atomic mass ki wajah se Be se zyada dense hain (Kitab ki ghalti dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki apni Table 17.1 ke mutabiq beryllium ki density Group 2 mein sab se zyada nahi: Be 1.85 g/cm³, Mg 1.74, Ca 1.54, Sr 2.64, Ba 3.51. Be sirf Mg aur Ca se zyada dense hai. Melting point (1287 °C) waqai sab se zyada hai.

blocks.prompt:
b) Why are Group 1 metals more reactive than Group 2 metals in the same period?
Aik hi period mein Group 1 metals Group 2 se zyada reactive kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Group 1 metal ka aik valence electron (ns¹) hai aur ionization energy kam hai, is liye M⁺ aasani se banta hai. Usi period ki Group 2 metal ka nuclear charge zyada aur atom chhota hai, aur use do electrons (ns²) chhorne parte hain jis ke liye bohat zyada energy (pehli + doosri ionization energy) chahiye. Is liye Group 1 zyada reactive hai (maslan Na pani se Mg ke muqable mein bohat tez reaction karta hai).

blocks.prompt:
c) Explain why calcium hydroxide is used in agriculture.
Calcium hydroxide zarat (agriculture) mein kyun istemal hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Calcium hydroxide (slaked lime) base hai. Tezaabi (acidic) zameen mein dalne se yeh tezaab ko neutralize kar ke pH barhata hai (OH⁻ + H⁺ → H₂O), jis se zameen faslon ke liye behtar ho jati hai. Yeh calcium bhi deta hai jo paudon ki cell wall ke liye zaroori ghiza hai.

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Describe the reactivity of Group 2 elements with water and dilute hydrochloric acid. Provide relevant chemical equations and differences in their reactivity.
Group 2 elements ki pani aur dilute hydrochloric acid ke saath reactivity equations aur farq ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Group 2 metals ke do valence electrons (ns²) hain; yeh in ko kho kar M²⁺ ions banate hain. Group mein neeche atomic size aur shielding barhti aur ionization energy kam hoti hai, is liye reactivity barhti hai:
Be < Mg < Ca < Sr < Ba

Pani ke saath: M(s) + 2H₂O(l) → M(OH)₂ + H₂(g)
• Be: garam karne par bhi pani ya steam se reaction nahi (hifazati oxide teh).
• Mg: thande pani se bohat aahista: Mg(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Mg(OH)₂ + H₂(g); steam se tez: Mg(s) + H₂O(g) → MgO(s) + H₂(g).
• Ca: thande pani se aasani se, Mg se tez: Ca(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Ca(OH)₂ + H₂(g); kam hal hone wala Ca(OH)₂ safed precipitate deta hai.
• Sr aur Ba: aur bhi tez: Ba(s) + 2H₂O(l) → Ba(OH)₂(aq) + H₂(g).
Neeche jaate hue hydroxides zyada hal aur zyada basic hote hain.

Dilute HCl ke saath: M(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MCl₂(aq) + H₂(g)
• Be: Be + 2HCl → BeCl₂ + H₂, oxide teh ki wajah se aahista.
• Mg: aasani se: Mg(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MgCl₂(aq) + H₂(g).
• Ca: tezi se: Ca(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂(g).
• Sr, Ba: sab se tez.
Dilute H₂SO₄ ke saath Ca (aur Sr, Ba) ka reaction jaldi ruk jata hai kyun ke kam hal hone wala sulphate metal par teh bana leta hai: Ca(s) + H₂SO₄(aq) → CaSO₄(s) + H₂(g).

Farq: products har dafa ek jaise hain, lekin raftaar Be (pani se koi reaction nahi) se Ba (bohat tez) tak barhti hai, ionization energy ke kam hone ke saath.

blocks.prompt:
Q5. Explain the thermal decomposition of carbonates and nitrates of Group 2 elements. Give reason and relative order of the ease of thermal stability.
Group 2 ke carbonates aur nitrates ki thermal decomposition, wajah aur stability ki tarteeb bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Thermal decomposition: garmi se compound ka saada cheezon mein tootna; yeh endothermic (garmi lene wala) hai.
Carbonates metal oxide aur carbon dioxide dete hain:
MCO₃(s) → MO(s) + CO₂(g)
MgCO₃(s) → MgO(s) + CO₂(g); CaCO₃(s) → CaO(s) + CO₂(g)
Nitrates metal oxide, bhoori NO₂ aur O₂ dete hain:
2M(NO₃)₂(s) → 2MO(s) + 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g)
2Ca(NO₃)₂(s) → 2CaO(s) + 4NO₂(g) + O₂(g)
Thermal stability ki tarteeb (neeche barhti hai):
BeCO₃ < MgCO₃ < CaCO₃ < SrCO₃ < BaCO₃ (250, 540, 900, 1289, 1360 °C par decomposition, Table 17.3)
Be(NO₃)₂ < Mg(NO₃)₂ < Ca(NO₃)₂ < Sr(NO₃)₂ < Ba(NO₃)₂
Tootne mein aasani ulti tarteeb mein hai: Be ke compounds sab se aasani se, Ba ke sab se mushkil se.
Wajah (polarizing power): chhota aur zyada charge wala cation, jaise Be²⁺, ki charge density zyada hai. Yeh CO₃²⁻ ya NO₃⁻ ke bare electron baadal ko bigaar (polarize) deta hai, C–O ya N–O bonds kamzor hote hain aur anion kam temperature par toot jata hai. Neeche M²⁺ bara hota hai, polarizing power kam hoti hai, anion kam bigarta hai aur zyada garmi chahiye.
Faida: decomposition temperature se na-maloom carbonates aur nitrates pehchane ja sakte hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: “chhota cation = zyada polarizing power = kam stable carbonate/nitrate”. Is liye BeCO₃ sirf 250 °C par toot jata hai aur BaCO₃ ko 1360 °C chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
Q6. Explain the solubility of sulphates and hydroxides of Group 2 elements, and discuss the trend in their solubility down the group with appropriate examples.
Group 2 ke sulphates aur hydroxides ki solubility aur group mein neeche un ka rujhan (trend) misalon ke saath bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Ionic compound ki solubility do energies par munhasir hai:
• Lattice enthalpy (ΔHlattice): aik mole thos ko gaseous ions mein todne ki energy (endothermic).
• Hydration enthalpy (ΔHhyd): gaseous ions ke gird pani ke molecules jama hone par nikalne wali energy (exothermic); chhote aur zyada charge wale ions ke liye zyada.
In dono ka majmui asar enthalpy of solution ΔHsoln hai; zyada negative (kam positive) ΔHsoln zyada solubility deta hai. Group 2 mein neeche cation bara hone se ΔHlattice aur ΔHhyd dono kam hoti hain; trend is par munhasir hai ke kaun zyada girti hai.
Hydroxides: solubility neeche barhti hai. OH⁻ chhota hai; M²⁺ bara hone par lattice enthalpy hydration enthalpy se zyada girti hai, is liye ΔHsoln mufeed hoti jati hai.
Mg(OH)₂ 2 × 10⁻⁵ < Ca(OH)₂ 1.5 × 10⁻³ < Sr(OH)₂ 3.4 × 10⁻³ < Ba(OH)₂ 1.5 × 10⁻² mol/100 g pani.
Misal: Mg(OH)₂ bohat kam hal hota hai (milk of magnesia), Ba(OH)₂ kafi hal hota hai.
Sulphates: solubility neeche kam hoti hai. SO₄²⁻ bara hai, is liye lattice enthalpy cation ke saath kam badalti hai; hydration enthalpy zyada girti hai, is liye ΔHsoln kam mufeed hoti hai.
MgSO₄ 1.83 × 10⁻¹ > CaSO₄ 4.66 × 10⁻³ > SrSO₄ 7.11 × 10⁻⁵ > BaSO₄ 9.43 × 10⁻⁷ mol/100 g pani.
Misal: MgSO₄ (Epsom salt) hal hota hai, BaSO₄ na-hal hai (barium meal mein mehfooz istemal).

rows: Lattice enthalpy hydration se zyada girti hai
Hydration enthalpy lattice se zyada girti hai
Mg(OH)₂ sab se kam, Ba(OH)₂ sab se zyada hal
MgSO₄ sab se zyada, BaSO₄ sab se kam hal

blocks.prompt:
Q7. Explain the process of extraction of Mg through Dow's method.
Dow ke tareeqe se Mg nikalne (extraction) ka amal bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Dow process samandari pani mein maujood Mg²⁺ ions se magnesium kai qadmon wale chemical aur electrochemical amal se nikalta hai.
1. Precipitation: samandari pani mein calcium hydroxide (limestone ya seepiyon se) dala jata hai jo na-hal magnesium hydroxide ko alag kar deta hai:
Mg²⁺(aq) + Ca(OH)₂(s) → Mg(OH)₂(s) + Ca²⁺(aq)
2. Chloride banana: Mg(OH)₂ ko filter kar ke hydrochloric acid se reaction karaya jata hai:
Mg(OH)₂(s) + 2HCl(aq) → MgCl₂(aq) + 2H₂O(l)
3. Gaarha karna aur sukhana: MgCl₂ solution ko gaarha (concentrate) kar ke sukhaya aur phir pighlaya jata hai.
4. Electrolysis: pighle hue MgCl₂ ki bare cells mein electrolysis hoti hai; cathode par khalis magnesium aur anode par chlorine gas banti hai:
Cathode: Mg²⁺(l) + 2e⁻ → Mg(l)
Anode: 2Cl⁻(l) → Cl₂(g) + 2e⁻
Majmui: Mg²⁺(l) + 2Cl⁻(l) → Mg(l) + Cl₂(g)
Ahmiyat: yeh aik qeemti metal ko aam lekin kam concentration wale zariye (samandari pani) se bohat bare sanati paimane par nikalta hai.
